title: A Single Man of Good Fortune

story.text: It is a truth universally acknowledged that a single man with a good {FORTUNE} must be in want of a {WIFE}. So when {NETHERFIELD} Park is finally let to a rich young gentleman, Mr. {BINGLEY}, Mrs. Bennet can think of nothing but seeing one of her five daughters {MARRIED} to him. Mr. Bennet only teases her, and she protests that he has no pity for her poor {NERVES}.
story.caption: Mr. and Mrs. Bennet
